Title: Ishaan's Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Anita - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Savitri - 70 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Tanay - 10 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Savitri stand near him.]

Ishaan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan sings a song.]

Ishaan: "Exactly right."

[Ishaan points at the sky.]

Savitri (surprised): "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan nods.]

Ishaan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ishaan scratches his head.]

Anita: "Good job, Ishaan!"

[Ishaan whispers something to Mother.]

Savitri (happily): "And then?"

[Ishaan takes the bag from Mother.]

Ishaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
